history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A handsome Indonesian soldier in a camouflage uniform stands confidently in front of a military truck. He is wearing a camouflage cap with a red and green emblem. His uniform has several patches, including one on his chest that reads "GHAZALI" and another that says "TNI AD" with wings above it. He also has a green armband on his left bicep. The soldier has his left hand on his hip and is looking directly at the camera with a slight smile. The military truck behind him is olive green and appears to be an older model. In the background, there is a light green building and a clear blue sky. The lighting suggests it is a sunny day, casting soft shadows. The overall mood of the image is proud and patriotic. The color palette is dominated by greens, browns, and blacks of the camouflage, with accents of red and green from the emblems and armband, and the olive green of the truck. The style is realistic, capturing the details of the uniform and the soldier's features.
